about.text: Our story, values, and commitment to exceptional craftsmanship

Founded in 2015, {brand}emerged from a vision to redefine luxury fashion for the modern connoisseur. What began as a small atelier in Florence has grown into a globally recognized name, celebrated for our uncompromising commitment to quality and timeless design.

Each piece in our collection represents a harmonious blend of traditional craftsmanship and contemporary sensibility. We work directly with master artisans across Italy and France, ensuring every detail meets our exacting standards of excellence.
Our philosophy centers on creating fashion that transcends trends—pieces designed to become cherished heirlooms, telling stories of artistry and sophistication for generations to come.
The foundation of everything we create
Every piece is meticulously handcrafted by master artisans, ensuring unparalleled quality and attention to detail that machine production cannot replicate.
We source materials responsibly and prioritize eco-friendly practices, believing that true luxury should honor both people and the planet.
We create pieces that transcend seasonal trends, focusing on enduring elegance and sophisticated silhouettes that remain relevant for years.
Our dedicated client advisors provide personalized attention, ensuring each customer finds pieces that perfectly complement their style and occasion.
Former head designer at a renowned Italian fashion house, Isabella brings 15 years of experience in luxury fashion design and textile innovation.
With a background in luxury retail management and sustainable business practices, Alexander ensures our operations align with our values.
Sophie oversees our artisan partnerships and production process, ensuring every piece meets our rigorous quality standards.
Connect with our team for personalized service and exclusive collections

contact.text: Connect with our luxury fashion advisors for personalized service
Find answers to common questions about our luxury fashion services
What is your return and exchange policy?

We offer a 30-day return policy for unworn items with original tags attached. Custom and made-to-order pieces are final sale. Return shipping is complimentary, and refunds are processed within 5-7 business days of receipt.
How do I care for my {brand} pieces?

Each piece includes specific care instructions. Generally, we recommend dry cleaning for delicate fabrics and hand washing for knitwear. Store garments in breathable garment bags and avoid direct sunlight to preserve colors.
Do you offer alterations or custom sizing?

Yes, we offer complimentary alterations for all ready-to-wear pieces purchased through our flagship store or personal shopping service. Custom sizing is available for select collections with an additional 4-6 week production time.
What shipping options do you offer?

We provide complimentary express shipping worldwide with full tracking and insurance. Orders typically ship within 1-2 business days and arrive in 3-5 business days domestically, 7-10 days internationally. White-glove delivery is available for couture pieces.
How can I book a personal shopping appointment?

Personal shopping appointments are available at our flagship stores in New York, Paris, and Milan. You can book through our website contact form, by calling our concierge line, or emailing appointments@elannoir.com. Appointments typically last 90 minutes.

The delicate hand-stitched embroidery and custom mother-of-pearl buttons showcase exceptional craftsmanship.
